cd /tmp && cat > design.py << 'EOF'
import RNA, json, random

target = "((..(((((........(.((..((.(.....(....).((((((((.........((......((((.....))))......))...((..((.......(..(......)..)..((..((.....((....)).((((.....(((.....(..((.(...).))..).....))).((((...(.......(..(.((...)).)..).......)...))))........)))).....((((((...)))))).))..))...........))..)).........(..((((....))((((((.....(........).....))))))..))..)...))))))))........).))..)).).....(.......).)))))..)).".replace(' ','')
n = len(target)

stack=[]
pairs={}
for i,c in enumerate(target):
    if c=='(':
        stack.append(i)
    elif c==')':
        j=stack.pop()
        pairs[j]=i
        pairs[i]=j

random.seed(42)

seq = ['A']*n

# assign pairs: GC or AU, alternate for variety, prefer GC for strength
pair_list = [(i,j) for i,j in pairs.items() if i<j]

gc_pairs = [('G','C'),('C','G')]
au_pairs = [('A','U'),('U','A')]
gu_pairs = [('G','U'),('U','G')]

for idx,(i,j) in enumerate(pair_list):
    # mostly GC, some AU for flexibility
    r = random.random()
    if r < 0.6:
        a,b = random.choice(gc_pairs)
    elif r < 0.9:
        a,b = random.choice(au_pairs)
    else:
        a,b = random.choice(gu_pairs)
    seq[i]=a
    seq[j]=b

# unpaired positions: fill with A mostly, but avoid long poly-A/U stretches causing issues; use some C
for i in range(n):
    if seq[i]=='A' and i not in pairs:
        seq[i] = 'A'

seq = ''.join(seq)
print(seq)
print(len(seq))

fc = RNA.fold_compound(seq)
mfe_struct, mfe = fc.mfe()
print(mfe_struct)
print(mfe)

# compare
diff = sum(1 for a,b in zip(mfe_struct, target) if a!=b)
print("diff", diff)
EOF

import multiprocessing as mp
import subprocess, sys

def run_one(args):
    seed, iters, budget = args
    out = subprocess.run(['python3','search.py',str(seed),str(iters),str(budget)], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=budget+30)
    line = out.stdout.strip().split('\n')[-1]
    parts = line.split(' ', 1)
    dist = int(parts[0])
    seq = parts[1]
    return dist, seq, seed

if __name__ == "__main__":
    n_workers = int(sys.argv[1]) if len(sys.argv)>1 else 64
    budget = float(sys.argv[2]) if len(sys.argv)>2 else 90
    iters = int(sys.argv[3]) if len(sys.argv)>3 else 20000
    tasks = [(seed, iters, budget) for seed in range(n_workers)]
    with mp.Pool(n_workers) as pool:
        results = pool.map(run_one, tasks)
    results.sort(key=lambda x: x[0])
    for dist, seq, seed in results[:10]:
        print(dist, seed, seq)
